summary: Frontend-only testing complete for ACTOOS ONE PWA. All requested features working correctly: Home page with 13 mocked restaurants, category filtering (Tout/Africain/Fast Food), filter options (Pickup/Offres/Mieux notés), favorites system with heart buttons, restaurant navigation, cookie consent banner, bottom navigation (Eats/Health/Wallet/Profil), promo banner with carousel and flash deals, and search functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: ESLint warnings in App.js: unused imports (useParams, BottomSheet, RatingSheet) and unused variables (appMode, navigateToRestaurant, navigateToPharmacy, navigateToHome, navigateToTab, user). Consider cleanup for code quality.
Missing dependency warning in useEffect (handlePharmacyClick, handleRestaurantClick) - not critical but should be addressed

test_credentials.note: No authentication required for guest-first PWA. Mock user 'Amadou Diallo' available in profile.

seed_data_creation: All data is MOCKED in frontend (mockData.js, menuData.js, healthData.js, promotionsData.js)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working. App uses mocked Supabase (localStorage fallback). Mobile-first design verified at 414x896 viewport.

home_page_loading.details: Home page loads with 13 mocked restaurants from mockData.js

category_filter.details: Categories work correctly - Tout (13), Africain (3), Fast Food (1). All categories have data-testid='category-{id}'

filter_options.details: Pickup, Offres, Mieux notés filters work. Filter toggle shows badge with active count. data-testid='filter-{id}'

favorites_system.details: Heart buttons on all 13 restaurant cards. Toggle works (white -> red). data-testid='favorite-btn-{restaurant.id}'

restaurant_navigation.details: Clicking restaurant card navigates to /restaurant/{id}. Back button returns to home. Menu items displayed.

cookie_consent_banner.details: Cookie consent sheet appears on first visit. Accept/Decline/Paramètres buttons work. data-testid='cookie-consent-sheet'

bottom_navigation.details: All 4 tabs work: Eats (home), Health (pharmacies), Wallet (balance), Profil (user profile). data-testid='nav-{id}'

promo_banner.details: Flash Deal -30% banner visible. Carousel with BIENVENUE and FREEWEEKEND promo codes. Auto-slides every 5 seconds.

search_functionality.details: Search sheet opens from search bar. Trending searches shown. Search for 'Pizza' returns 1 result. data-testid='search-input'

screens_verified.home: Restaurant feed with cards, categories, filters, promo banner
screens_verified.restaurant: Menu with categories (Plats principaux, Accompagnements, Boissons), prices in FCFA
screens_verified.health: 5 pharmacies listed with ratings, distance, delivery time
screens_verified.wallet: ACTOOS Pay with 15,000 FCFA balance, Recharger/Envoyer/Payer/Encaisser actions, transaction history
screens_verified.profile: User info, referral code ACTOOS-AD01, Devenir Partenaire/Livreur, Mes commandes, Mes favoris

design_verification.light_mode_only: PASS - No dark mode toggle, consistent light theme
